comment: Status rules (docs/RELEASES.md): 'available' only after the file was installed and tested on a real device; 'preview' runs with the stated limitation; 'soon' has no file. Sizes and SHA-256 are computed by tools/build.py, never typed.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.text: The phone app. Open the file on your phone and allow installing from your browser when Android asks.

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.text: The computer companion: pairs, shows live diagnostics and passes rumble. Games on Mac can't see the controller yet — that needs a permission from Apple. Not notarized yet: after the first launch is blocked, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.

platforms.name: iPhone
platforms.text: The iPhone app is built and tested on an iPhone 15. Apple only allows public installs through the App Store or TestFlight, which comes next.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.text: Windows needs a signed driver so games see a real controller. It is not shipped until that driver is signed.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.text: Linux works today: games see a standard Xbox 360-style controller. Packages are on the way.
